title: Logical Operator
text: Perform specified logical operation on input, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Operator} sets Logical operator; {Number of input ports} sets the number of inputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Require all inputs and output to have the same data type} requires all ports to have same data type, {Output data type}, {Mode} sets the category of data to specify, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness}, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized and {Scaling} sets the method of scaling. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First input signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Second input signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_N
ports.summary: Nth input signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Operator
params.values: Logical operator AND (default) | OR | NAND | NOR | XOR | NXOR | NOT

params.name: Require all inputs and output to have the same data type
params.values: Require all ports to have same data type off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type boolean (default) | Inherit: Logical (see Configuration Parameters: Optimization) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Category of data to specify Built in (default) | Inherit | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Signedness of fixed-point data Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32
